description: Website for a eutony specialist facilitator business.

features.name: project_scaffolding
features.title: Scaffold Astro + Tailwind + Vitest
features.description: Bootstrap the eutonia website with the latest Astro, Tailwind CSS and Vitest, wired through the project harness.
acceptance: package.json defines astro, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/vite and vitest
astro.config.mjs registers the Tailwind Vite plugin
src/pages/index.astro renders a landing page through a shared layout
tests/ contains a Vitest suite and `npm test` passes
./init.sh finishes with exit code 0

features.name: style
features.title: Styles and vibe
features.description: Set the preferences for styles and vibes in the web
acceptance: The website if focused in a relaxed and mindful physical and spiritual treatment following the eutonic teachings.
The primary color is #5c5f3f followed by #3f5c5f and #5f3f5c
The font must be a formal one sometimes mixed with something more organic in some places.
The primary action will be 'Reservar' followed by 'Contacto'
Public: People from Buenos Aires in search of whole body-mind treatment.
Title: Eutonia... y algo más
Traffic: Instagram, Google search, Google maps
Mobile priority: Yes

features.name: header
features.title: Header
features.description: Create the header
acceptance: The logo is in 'public/logo.svg' and it is in the header of the page
The header contains 3 sections. Inicio, Sobre mí, Contacto, Reservar

features.name: first_section
features.title: First section
features.description: Create the first section that the user will see.
acceptance: The first section will contain the picture 'public/photos/start.jpg'
Aligned to the left will be a short text of about 50 words to encourage and inspire people to listen to their body.
This section will cover the starting 100% of the screen.

features.name: first_section_fix
features.title: First section fix
features.description: Fix little details.
acceptance: The fonts are not shown in the web
Align the text to the right of the photo
Make sure the hight of the first section and the header is exactly 100hv

features.name: description
features.title: Description with icons
features.description: Show how it work and what to expect from the practice.
acceptance: Add a section that contain 3 boxes
The boxes contain an icon a title and a short text
1st box: icon: public/meditation.svg. title: '¿Que es?'.text:  'Una disciplina de trabajo corporal conciente nacida en occidente con el espíritu  de oriente.'.
2nd box: icon: public/grow.svg . title:'¿Cuál es su objetivo?'. text:'Que aprendas a regular tu tono corporal, tu estado de tensión. Sintiendo y observando tu cuerpo'.
3rd box: icon: public/mind.svg. title:'¿Qué efectos tiene?'. text:'Disminuye el estrés regula la respiración y el ritmo cardíaco. Se integra cuerpo, mente, emoción.'.

features.name: gerda
features.title: Photo and prase of Alexander Gerda
features.description: Show a quote from the inventor of the discipline.
acceptance: Add a section with a photo and quote from Gerda Alexander.
The photo is in public/photos/gerda.webp
The quote will be : Es preciso aprender cada día un poco más que somos ese cuerpo en el cual podemos apoyarnos.

features.name: animations
features.title: Animations
features.description: Add animations to te home page
acceptance: Add animations to the homepage, the animations should be aligned to the vibe of the page.
The hero text should have an animation at when the page is loaded
The gerda section should have animations, for both the text and the picture. The picture animation should start and end, then the text should apear

features.name: plans
features.title: Plans
features.description: Add the plans that the user can choose from.
acceptance: Add at least 3 boxes to display the available plans to take the courses.

Show the title big enough to draw attention, 'Lugar' where this is happening, 'horario' days and hours, and how many times per month. At the end add buttons to 'Reservar' use the other colors to emphasize and make it more appealing
The provisory plans will be: Online, Mensual, 1 Clase. You can fill the other details for now.

features.name: location
features.title: Location
features.description: Add a map where this is happening
acceptance: The title of this section will be '¿Dónde nos encontramos?'
Add a map from google maps to show the location where the encounters are happening
In one of the sides add the direction of just the text with a nice design. The direction is: Gymdance. Gral. Lavalle 2993, Victoria, Provincia de Buenos Aires

features.name: contact
features.title: Contact
features.description: Add the contact action buttons
acceptance: Add a section to contact the facilitator
A button will take you to the whatsapp chat with the facilitator in a new tab.
The mobile number is +54 9 11 4060-9024
Modify the contact button in the header to perform the same action, to this button ad some stile but keep in mind this is the second most important action.

features.name: eutonia
features.title: Eutonia
features.description: Add a new page: Eutonía.
acceptance: Add a new nav button: Eutonía, it will take you to a new page that explains what eutonia is.
Add a new page: eutonia.
Centered and at the top will be an image located in public/full-tree.svg
After the image wil begin the explanation in detail of what it is and how it was conceived. Mix images, sublines, colors and abstract patterns to the text to make dynamic, refreshing and interesting.

features.name: about
features.title: About
features.description: Add a new page: Sobre mí.
acceptance: Use the 'Sobre mí' nav button to go to the Sobre mí page.
Add a new page: Sobre mí.

At the top left corner will be an image of the facilitator, at is right will start the text that will explain who this person is, their carreer journey and how them found and became involved with the eutonic practice. Mix images, sublines, colors and abtrasct patterns to the text to make dynamic, refreshing and interesting.

features.name: fixed-button
features.title: 'Reservar' button
features.description: Add a button with the primary action shown in every page.
acceptance: Add a fixed button to 'Reservar'
The button will draw attention.
The button will be shown on every page, with two exceptions, when the scrollbar is at the top and when the plans are fully in the view.
Modify the 'Reservar' nav button to mach the fixed one and style them both to make sure the user understands that this is the primary action
The fixed and nav buttons will take to the plans section in the home page.

features.name: fix-tests
features.title: Fix failing test
features.description: Fix test
acceptance: Fix the failing tests to match the updated version of the site data.

features.name: review-section
features.title: Add a review section
features.description: Add a Review section on the home page
acceptance: Add a new section to show reviews.
The new section will be after the plans.
The section will show 3 reviews.
The reviews will have an icon of a person, a name, a 5-star rating and the comment.

features.name: animations
features.title: Animations
features.description: Add animations to te 'Eutonia' page
acceptance: Add animations to the 'eutonia' page, the animations should be aligned to the vibe of the page.
The hero text should have an animation at when the page is loaded
All the sections should have animations, for both the text and the picture.

features.name: review-section-edit
features.title: Review section edit
features.description: Style the review section differently
acceptance: The review will be shown in a carrousel.
The carrousel will be infinite.
The carrousel will have at the bottom two arrows to move the current review
The right arrow will have the background of the accent color
The carrousel will not move automatically but with the arrows
The current review will be 60% width.
The current review will be scaled at 110
All reviews will be visible, but the two on the sides will have a horizontal fade.
All the items will be centered, the stars at the top, then the review and finally the icon next to the name

features.name: instagram-link
features.title: Instagram link
features.description: Add a button to connect through instagram
acceptance: The footer will have an instagram button.
The button will be at the right of the whatsapp button
The colors of the instagram button will be inverted in relation to the whatsapp button
It will have the corresponding icon
The link will be https://www.instagram.com/eutoniaymeditacion/

features.name: seo-week-1
features.title: SEO week 1 quick wins
features.description: Implement the first-week SEO improvements from docs/seo-report.md
acceptance: The site origin is configured in Astro and every page has a canonical URL.
Open Graph and Twitter card tags are rendered on every page.
A 1200x630 social preview image is served from /og/.
robots.txt and a generated sitemap are available.
The home page has exactly one h1.
Titles and meta descriptions follow the report recommendations.
Trailing slashes are normalised and redirect to one canonical form.
The test suite passes.
